From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-call exec recap & next steps — Redwood inference POC for Solaris Health

Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick executive recap from our call and proposed next steps so your team (and exec sponsors) have a single source of truth.

Key pain points you confirmed:
- High volume of inbound triage leads (clinical and admin) causing >24h response time.
- Manual triage cost and onboarding delays for new providers.
- Need to keep PHI in-region and auditable for audits.

Target business outcomes (what success looks like):
- Reduce triage response time by ~40% within first 3 months of POC.
- Reduce per-triage operational cost by 30% via automation + caching.
- Maintain auditability and retention controls to meet upcoming SOC/State audits.

Technical & risk notes:
- Solaris will require SOC 2 Type II evidence and a VPC/private deployment option for PHI flows — Redwood has both (link to security pack below).
- Integration points: EHR webhook for triage events; we discussed using a small event-forwarding lambda for initial POC.

Procurement path & timing:
- Preferred flow: Procurement + legal call -> term sheet -> SOW/PO -> POC kickoff (4–6 week target).
- You mentioned this quarter’s budget is reserved for digital transformation — good fit for a Q2 POC.

Proposed next steps (action owners):
1) Marissa (me): send POC outline + term sheet (attached) and propose procurement/legal timeslots.
2) Alex / Priya: confirm exec sponsor and point legal/procurement contact.
3) Aditya (SE): schedule a 90-min technical deep-dive to finalize integration scope.

Attachments: redwood-poc-outline.pdf (POC scope, metrics), term-sheet-v1.docx (baseline pricing).

If this looks right, can you confirm Priya Desai as the exec sponsor and share a preferred 30-min slot for a procurement/legal introduction next week?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0187

Subject: Exec recap — Redwood POC outcomes & procurement path

Priya / Alex — Laura here (Sales Ops). Wanted to provide a very short executive-level summary for your leadership and clarify escalation points so your procurement and legal reviews go smoothly.

Executive summary (TL;DR):
- Business outcomes: Reduce triage response time ~40% and lower per-event cost through model optimization and caching. POC goal is to validate these gains against a representative triage volume.
- Risk posture: Redwood supports SOC 2 Type II, VPC/private deployment, and per-tenant retention controls. If SOC2 evidence is not acceptable to Solaris’ auditors, we can explore a private deployment + additional logging for auditability.
- Procurement path: Intro call with procurement/legal -> term-sheet agreement (attached v1) -> SOW/PO for pilot -> pilot kickoff. Typical review window for enterprise legal is 1–3 weeks; we will prioritize and provide redline-friendly terms.

Escalation items (if they arise):
- Security blocker: if SOC/PII requirements cannot be met, escalate to Redwood Security (cc: security@redwood.ai) for a technical remediation plan.
- Timeline risk: if procurement takes >4 weeks, we recommend an interim evaluation with a limited sandbox environment to keep momentum.

Marissa will coordinate scheduling. Aditya will be your SE owner for technical scoping. We look forward to partnering on this.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Senior Director, Enterprise Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
